utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I've got it confirmed: the repair drive is Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That works. Have you checked with Rey if he's got the repair station ready for lawn mowers?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet—thanks for the reminder. I'll swing by his place after lunch to double-check.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm glad you're coming to the repair drive, Dane. What can I help you with?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Sam—did I miss anything important for the repair drive? I've got my toolbox ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane! You're just in time—we're about to start. Glad you brought your toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive! We're meeting at the community center at 10 AM tomorrow to fix up the Smiths' fence. Don't forget your toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, tomorrow? Are you sure it's not Saturday? I thought we had more time to prepare.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, you're right! I think it's Saturday at 9 AM at the community center. Sorry for the mix-up!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye! Are you coming to the repair drive tomorrow? We're fixing stuff at the community center at 10!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I didn't realize it was tomorrow! Let me check my calendar—I can definitely help coordinate the sign-ups if you still need that.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That'd be amazing, Faye! I've got a stack of flyers in my bag if you want to hand some out too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Cleo, I'm mapping out stops for the repair drive. Do you have any specific addresses you'd like the drive to visit?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, good question! Let me think—I don't have specific addresses, but I heard we're focusing on the community center and maybe some fences nearby. Rosa mentioned it's Sunday now, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sunday, yes — that's the day. The community center's a strong anchor point; I'll add it to the list. Any particular fence spots you've heard about?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, Quinn — I think the repair drive is this Saturday, but I'm not entirely sure. Did Mara confirm the time?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, Leo's garage at 10am Saturday is the official word—I've been telling everyone to show up with something to fix!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, 10am Saturday at Leo's—I'll try to remember that this time. If I show up late, just blame my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, folks. Just a reminder, the repair drive is Saturday at 9 AM sharp at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hold up, Eli—the repair drive is at my garage at 10am, not 9 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Leo, I've got it written down as 9 AM at the community center. Let's double-check so we're all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I'm finally hauling my old lawnmower over!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, good, you're bringing something! I'm still waiting on a few confirmations—I set a Friday deadline so we can sort out pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, a Friday deadline? That's smart—I'll make sure to get my lawnmower confirmed by then!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I heard something about that. What's the gist of it again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's a neighborhood thing where we bring broken items and fix them together. Rosa's organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, right—fixing stuff together. I think I heard Leo mention it's at his garage on Saturday. I might bring that old toaster if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Rey, glad you're bringing your soldering iron! That'll come in handy for the small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I'm looking forward to putting it to good use.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, with your soldering skills and my wrench set, we'll be unstoppable on Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm planning to bring my squeaky lawn mower.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds great, Ira! I've got a flickering lamp I've been meaning to fix—maybe I'll bring it along too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, that lamp should be an easy one for Gus—he's a wizard with electrical stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Gus, great news—we moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center! Still need your help, though.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sunday works for me, I'll bring my tool kit and be there to help out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Gus! That's a big relief—your toolkit will come in handy for those fence repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Faye! I'm glad it works. I'll make sure we have a good list of tools ready—Cleo was asking about that too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that's great Cleo's asking about tools—maybe I can check with Opal if she has a running list of addresses for us to cover on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's a good thought, Faye—Opal does have a list of addresses, and I'll share it with everyone tomorrow. Thanks for checking!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: So it's Saturday at 10 at Leo's? Got it, I'll try to remember this time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that's right. I'll make sure to bring my toolbox as well.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, see you there. I'll dig out that old toaster if I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I've got the repair drive set for Saturday—planning to be at the community center around 10 with extra gloves if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday at 10, right! I'll try to remember that. Thanks for bringing gloves—I always lose mine.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No problem, Oren. I'll bring a few extra sizes just in case.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Uli, don't worry about your tools—I've got plenty to share. Just bring yourself and whatever you want to fix, and we'll figure it out together.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I'll bring that old lamp of mine—I’ve been meaning to see if it can spark up again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I've got a soft spot for lamps. Bring it by and we'll get that flicker sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Eli, I think we should set a deadline for people to confirm their participation in the repair drive, so we can plan pickup times without last-minute chaos.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great idea, Pia. Let's say confirm by noon Thursday so I can sort the pickup routes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Noon Thursday sounds perfect. I'll start contacting the neighbors to make sure they know the cutoff.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Opal, just getting ready for the repair drive this Saturday. You bringing anything to fix?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've got a list of stops mapped out already. Do you have any specific addresses you want me to add to the route?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just my garage at 42 Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: So, what should I bring—my flickering lamp, or just some cookies and good vibes?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Both, definitely! Your lamp will be a fun challenge, and cookies are always a hit—bring 'em along!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, I'll grab the lamp and whip up some chocolate chip cookies!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Ira, just a heads-up—the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. I'm bringing a hammer and screwdrivers, and I've got extra gloves if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, thanks Cleo—I didn't realize the day changed. I'll grab my toolbox and meet you there Sunday morning.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, glad you're on board! I think folks are aiming to start around 10, so I'll see you then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, have you checked with Rey if the repair station's ready for lawn mowers yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can ask around to see who else might need their mower fixed—plus I've got a spare blade if needed!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good thinking, Jules. But we still need to confirm with Rey if the station can handle mowers—can you check with him?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Hana, thanks for coming! We're just about to start the repair drive—bikes and small appliances over by the tables.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait—I thought Eli said it starts at 9 AM sharp. Did the time change?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh no, it's still 9 AM—we're just getting set up early. Grab a coffee and join us whenever you're ready!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, Tess, the repair drive... is that today? Or was it yesterday? I can't keep track.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No, it's this Saturday! I'm finally bringing my old lawnmower—you should come too, they fix stuff for free!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Saturday, right! ...Wait, what time again? I think I forgot that part too.
